title: Envelope
description: An event published to NATS on subject agenthub.<type>. The workspace comes from the server-side write that produced the event, never from client input.

id.description: Event id. Also the Nats-Msg-Id, so consumers dedupe on it.

type.description: Dotted event name, e.g. runtime.connected. Selects the payload schema in events/.

version.description: Payload schema version for this type.

correlation_id.description: Shared by every event that stems from the same originating request.

causation_id.description: Id of the event or request that directly caused this one.
